name: Law2_ScGeom_VirtualLubricationPhys
description: Virtual class for sheared lubrication functions. This don't do any computation and shouldn't be used directly!

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Textual label for this object; must be a valid python identifier, you can refer to it directly from python.

attributes.name: timingDeltas
attributes.description: Detailed information about timing inside the Dispatcher itself. Empty unless enabled in the source code and O.timingEnabled==True.

attributes.name: bases
attributes.description: Ordered list of types (as strings) this functor accepts.

methods.name: getStressForEachBody
methods.description: Get stresses tensors for each bodies: normal contact stress, shear contact stress, normal lubrication stress, shear lubrication stress, stress from additionnal potential forces.

methods.name: getTotalStresses
methods.description: Get total stresses tensors: normal contact stress, shear contact stress, normal lubrication stress, shear lubrication stress, stress from additionnal potential forces.
